content:
Then in turn the lord of men Agamemnon addressed him:
“Son of Laertes, I rejoice to hear your speech:
for in due measure you have gone through everything and set it forth.
And I am willing to swear this, and my heart commands me,
nor will I swear falsely by a god. But let Achilles
stay where he is, eager though he be for the work of Ares (for battle);
and let all the others remain assembled, until the gifts
come from my hut and we cut faithful oaths.
And this I enjoin and command you yourself:
after choosing out the best youths of all the Achaeans,
bring the gifts from my ship, all that we promised
yesterday to give to Achilles, and to bring the women.
And let Talthybius quickly through the wide camp of the Achaeans
make ready a boar to cut up for Zeus and for Helios.”
